_comment: Quiz category rotation and topic rules (Giulia, 10 Nov 2026). The weekly run picks each week's 3 quizzes from here and adds a history entry for every quiz it makes.
rules: Go round the rotation in order; never the same category twice in a row.

Fandom = one franchise people love (e.g. Friends, Stranger Things, Harry Potter, Disney, Pokemon). Research each week which fandoms people love and search for right now (vidIQ, YouTube trends, channel data).
A topic (fandom, franchise, show, film series, band, sport, etc.) is not repeated within 365 days of its last quiz.
Family-friendly only: never anything sexual, graphic, hateful or otherwise inappropriate. Pick topics that suit a general audience on a quiz channel.
Education = a school topic (e.g. a Victorian Curriculum science unit for Years 7-12).

Difficulty (trial from 16 Nov 2026, Giulia: "let's trial your recommendation"; Quiz #10 Disney lost 60% of viewers by Q3 vs 35% for Quiz #9): every quiz, fandom included, is medium. Questions 1-5 are easy and well known, the middle builds, and the hardest come in the second half (Q36-50). Fandom quizzes ask what a real fan knows, not obscure trivia.

Topics: start from the competitor research step (docs/weekly-automation.md section 1, docs/competitor-research.md): prefer topics, title styles, thumbnail styles and question types proven by quiz videos with 1M+ views, written in our own words.

performance_rank._comment: Re-ranked every Monday from the weekly report (first-week views, then average view duration, then CTR). General Knowledge is fixed as quiz 1 each week; quizzes 2 and 3 cycle through the top 3 below (Giulia, 23 Nov 2026).
